Bhavna Chatterjee | bhavna.chatterjee282@example.com | +91 9609000601
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
Senior backend-focused developer with experience building scalable payment and consumer-facing systems. Notice period: 15 days.

Senior Node.js Developer, Paystack India — Jun 2022 - Present
Led backend services for payment processing features, implementing microservices and improving latency for transaction APIs. Designed and shipped a reconciliation worker in Node.js that reduced end-of-day settlement delays by 45% using TypeScript and MongoDB for event storage. Migrated archival data to S3 and optimized query patterns on MongoDB and RDS, cutting storage costs 30%. Built Lambda and EC2-based alerting playbooks on AWS integrating with existing monitoring; used Git, Jira, and Confluence for development and documentation.

Full Stack Developer, Swiggy — Jan 2019 - May 2022
Developed order management and partner onboarding modules using TypeScript and Node.js; introduced backend batching that improved throughput by 60%. Architected a high-availability session store on MongoDB and tuned RDS queries for analytics pipelines. Implemented S3-backed asset storage and autoscaled EC2 instances for peak traffic. Coordinated cross-functional work through Jira and documented runbooks in Confluence; maintained code in Git.

Full Stack Developer, Accenture — Feb 2018 - Dec 2018
Contributed to cloud-native application builds for enterprise clients using Node.js and TypeScript. Implemented data synchronization to MongoDB and RDS, and deployed services to AWS EC2 and S3. Automated CI workflows with Git and tracked project tasks in Jira; produced design notes and onboarding docs in Confluence.

Skills: Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, RDS, S3, EC2, Confluence, Git, Jira

Education: B.E., Information Technology, Pune University
